criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 01, 09, 06 and 03/04 hold up; 07 primitives with two disjoint plates and a pastel board; 05 a chart grid with invisible tape; 02 a CAD plan; 08 type on a plate; 03/04 evenly lit with a tan crown. Four frames on primitives or defaults puts it under 7.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Untextured primitives on a boom with two disconnected plates, a flat pastel board, a black blob at its corner.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Reuse the chassis camera on one plate and one jointed arm; marker lanes and case blocks in the deck's colours with a specular streak; soft casts from frame and tray.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A mid grey chart grid; the white tape invisible at 432 px.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A raised band at L* 85 or more with its own cast; lids in a pool and the empty bays to black.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A CAD plan, cameras as dark stubs.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A 30 to 40 degree three quarter view; pale lit camera housings.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A beige page over 60 percent of the frame at uniform mid tone.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Angle and bleed the page, light only its upper half and the clip.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: An evenly lit wall, a tan crown, no bleed.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A hard rake from high left with a specular edge on the gold rows; widen so the wall bleeds; mirror on 3.

_note: Transcribed from the judge's hand-back by the showrunner; scores, total and weakest frames as returned, reasons abridged.
